## Important Dates

Submission deadline (Paper & Demo): November 15, 2026 23:59 AoE *(Extended)*

Workshop: December 7, 2026

**Review process**: Papers will undergo single-blind review.
Review notifications will be sent out on a rolling basis from November 2 to November 20.
Papers will be reviewed as submissions are received, and we will make every effort to notify authors of the review results as early as possible.

**Presentation**: Accepted papers will be presented as posters. Selected papers will additionally be invited for short spotlight presentations.

**Publication policy**: No formal proceedings (we are a non-archival workshop). Authors are welcome to post their papers on arXiv.

### Call for Demos

Demo submissions are now open! The deadline is **November 15, 2026** (23:59 AoE). Paper and demo submissions use the same OpenReview portal.
